results.title: Yami and Aditya reportedly relocate
results.description: Aditya Dhar and Yami Gautam Dhar have reportedly made Himachal Pradesh their permanent base, choosing a quieter life away from Mumbai. Yami owns a 100-year-old heritage home on a 25-acre estate in Gohar, Mandi. The couple hasn't officially confirmed the move and keeps their personal life, including son Vedavid, private.

results.title: Chiranjeevi REACTS to morphed Chuttamalle video featuring Jr NTR and Janhvi Kapoor, vows action
results.description: A manipulated video linked to the Devara song has sparked concern in the Telugu film industry, with Chiranjeevi speaking out against the incident.

results.title: Taylor Swift makes surprise cameo during Dakota Johnson’s SNL monologue
results.description: Swift, who recently appeared alongside the actress in the music video for her new song Patient Zero, joined her on stage to huge applause.
